summary: HR Manager with over a decade of progressive experience aligning workforce strategy with business goals at an industry-leading organization. Skilled in employee relations, labor negotiations, and compensation program design, with a record of reducing turnover and resolving complex staffing disputes.

experience.title: HR Manager
bullets: Serve as the primary link between management and 600+ employees, interpreting and administering contracts and resolving work-related problems with a 92% first-contact resolution rate.
Direct and supervise a team of four HR generalists covering employment, compensation, labor relations, and employee relations activities.
Negotiate bargaining agreements with two union chapters, reaching settlements without work stoppage in three consecutive cycles.
Advise managers on equal employment opportunity and harassment policy matters, delivering quarterly training that cut formal complaints by 30%.
Analyze and modify compensation and benefits policies against market benchmarks, keeping total rewards competitive and legally compliant.

experience.title: Senior HR Generalist
bullets: Performed difficult staffing duties, including refereeing disputes, administering disciplinary procedures, and managing reductions in force across three sites.
Represented the organization at personnel-related hearings and investigations, sustaining a favorable outcome in 11 of 13 cases.
Planned and conducted new employee orientation for 200+ hires annually, improving 90-day retention by 18%.
Partnered with finance to redesign the bonus structure, aligning payouts with measurable performance targets.

experience.title: HR Generalist
bullets: Administered employee relations programs and interpreted labor contracts for a workforce of 350 clinical and administrative staff.
Coordinated recruitment and onboarding, trimming average time-to-fill from 52 to 34 days.
Supported compensation surveys and benefits enrollment, maintaining full compliance with legal requirements.
Monitored employee satisfaction data and recommended policy changes adopted by leadership.

experience.title: HR Assistant
bullets: Supported daily HR operations, maintaining personnel records and answering employee questions on benefits and policies.
Assisted with new employee orientation sessions and background check processing for 400+ annual hires.
Compiled monthly staffing and turnover reports used by management for workforce planning.
